s01_finding.empirically_confirmed: The 'exclude FAMILY_REL' idea for S01 does NOT create a genuine second interpretation. Tested live on two fresh subjects (Amanda Alexander: 13/13 identical; Arthur Willis: 10/10 identical) — because every specific KNOWS-family edge (incl. FAMILY_REL) has a parallel generic :KNOWS edge (re-confirmed: specific_without_generic=0, same fact 9.1 already found), the broad union and the union-minus-FAMILY_REL always return the same person set. This is structural, not fixable by rewording — it's the same root bug as S02/S04/S05/S06/S10, just one level removed. Recommendation: retype S01's [r] to the explicit union (matches its current default_interp text) and accept it becomes single-interpretation like the old S02 was — OR swap S01 for a 7th fresh replacement on the digital-comm axis, same shape as the 6 below. Your call — flagging the empirical result, not deciding for you.
